authority: explicit block lists reconstructed by validated metadata/data closure traversal; never segment counters alone

states.Free: no retained or pending owner; old bytes need no erasure
states.Active: conceptual only; allocator seals complete full-snapshot segments without exposed append mode
states.Sealed: current closure owns blocks; no new allocation to unused offsets
states.Cleaning: admitted plan reservation (transient under exclusive synchronous API)
states.Retired: fallback-only ownership; blocked until durable slot invalidation
states.Quarantined: frozen/degraded owner marks every segment unsafe

runtime_only_disk_blocks: unsupported by design; handles own copied memory and every remaining orphan stays mapped. Runtime-only physical liveness fixture is NOT_APPLICABLE, not a simulated hidden owner.

tests.dead: F2 plus F1 actual obsolete nonzero tail and eventual source release
tests.live: F12 populated segments and protected bootstrap shared ownership
tests.mixed: F1 observed reused dense segment with obsolete nonzero tail
tests.runtime: F5 actual open/dup/unlink/read offsets, copied orphan backing
tests.reservation: fault matrix exact pending block counts after admission
tests.uncertain: fault matrix and changed-source test freeze all segments

traversal_budget: actual aggregate caller read limit enforced by a read-only device wrapper, plus 65536 reads per closure; changed-larger-valid-graph test exhausts exactly its declared read budget with no writes and frozen owner
selection: sort current-only sealed candidates by live block count then index; equal segment sizes make this exact ratio ordering; fallback-only and shared segments skipped
evidence: raw final qualification profile/sfs4 fixtures, ownership dumps, traces and images
